Results.ReviewText: This is my third Weber grill of this size.  I am not pleased with the changes made.  First and foremost the wheels on the other two legs have been removed which makes moving the grill more awkward.  Secondly the little hole on the base that allowed me to see if the propane was still running without opening the cover is no longer there.  Lastly the closed box is no longer there, it just has an open space.  The grill works fine but the design certainly is much less user friendly
Results.Title: Disappointed

Results.ReviewText: Bought to replace a 20 year old weber three burner grill. This E-310 is built really well with quality parts (I know because I assembled it myself). I really prefer the burners running vertically from front to back as my previous model burners ran side to side. The battery powered igniter is also really well done. Rust in the lower cabinet killed my previous Weber, but this one looks like it will last at least two decades. It is performing flawlessly.
Results.Title: More Modern replacement.

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
